findings.reason: The evidence confirms the change and the anomaly, but does not prove causality; the root cause is an inference not explicitly stated in the cited text.
T1 and T6 both explicitly state that RRC success drops and drop rate spikes affected the three sites starting at 2026-09-29 17:30.
The cited change records confirm that OPT-21 was applied to the three specific sites at 2026-09-29 17:31.
T6 explicitly reports 'no deviation' for prb_util_pct on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015.
T7 explicitly states that no maintenance window was scheduled on the specified nodes and parents within the given time window.
The cited changes confirm the rollback at 01:13, but the evidence does not state that this action resolved the issue.
